_note: Sanitized reference covering the search-discovery and email-extraction stages. Real credentials, spreadsheet IDs, and search-topic keyword lists replaced with placeholders. Control flow and dedup/retry logic are unchanged from production.

search_stage.description: A launcher fans query sets out to a parallel worker sub-workflow (n8n Execute Workflow node, 'each' mode). Each set of ~5 search-engine queries runs as its own parallel worker invocation rather than one long sequential loop.

nodes.name: Query Sets (N per set)
nodes.note: Hardcoded array of query-set objects ({setName, queries[]}), one item per set. Real deployment used ~23 sets of 5 topic-variant queries each (e.g. 'guest post <topic>', 'write for us <topic>', 'submit article <topic>', 'contribute <topic> blog', 'guest post guidelines <topic>') covering several related service topics - deliberately varied phrasing since search engines rank these query patterns differently.

worker_sub_workflow.name: Generate Page Requests
worker_sub_workflow.note: Expands each {setName, queries[]} into one item per (query, page) pair - 2 result pages per query.

worker_sub_workflow.name: Filter & Dedupe Domains
worker_sub_workflow.note: Excludes forum/social/video-platform domains (discussion boards, YouTube, TikTok, Medium) since those aren't guest-post-able blogs, then dedupes by root domain within the run.

extraction_stage.description: Polls the prospect sheet on a schedule, batches unprocessed rows, and resolves an email address per domain through a two-step fallback (homepage, then /contact-us/) with a documented extraction/junk-filtering pass.

nodes.name: Get Next Batch
nodes.note: Filters to rows not yet Done/No-Email, and not yet at max retry attempts on prior Errors; sorts by original row order; caps batch size.

nodes.name: Fetch Homepage
nodes.note: onError continues rather than halting the batch - one unreachable site never blocks the rest.

nodes.name: Extract Emails Primary
nodes.note: Regex email extraction with a real junk-filtering pass: strips script/style tags first, rejects file-extension false-positives (matches ending in .png/.jpg/.css/etc that regex mistakes for TLDs), rejects a placeholder-domain denylist (example.com, yourcompany.com, ...), rejects a placeholder-local-part denylist (noreply, test, johndoe, ...), rejects 32-char hex strings (tracking pixel IDs misread as emails), and fixes a specific encoding artifact where obfuscated mailto links decode with a stray 'u0041'-style unicode-escape prefix stuck to the front of the local part.

nodes.name: Fetch Contact Page
nodes.note: Fallback fetch of /contact-us/ only runs if the homepage pass found nothing - avoids a second request per domain in the common case.

nodes.name: Extract Emails Fallback
nodes.note: Same extraction logic as the primary pass; final status becomes Done (email found), No Email (both pages fetched cleanly, nothing found), or Error (a fetch itself failed, eligible for retry up to the attempt cap).
